resources.string: This section is to manage all the Email Groups in PBC. From here can create new Groups, modify or remove any existing email group.
Enter new email and owner name to add the email to the selected email group.
Do you want to remove this email from this email group? Once you remove this, this recipient will not receive any email related to this email group.
Enter new email group name and upload a .csv file that contain all the emails that need to add into this group. You can download the required .csv file template from here too.
Missing email-group name or missing email list .csv file. Please provide them and create email group again.
Do you want to delete this email-group? Once you delete this, you will no longer have accesses to those emails and application will not prompt this email group to send emails in the future.
This section is to manage all users in PBC. From here can admin can see user details and modify user roles.
Basic information and available contact details about selected user.
This is to assign new role to selected user. You can select any predefined user roles in the app and assign that to user. Below drop-down menu already selected the current role of the selected user.
Are you sure to delete this user?

Do you want to delete this user? Once you delete this user, that user's complete data will remove from the system and that user will lose their login and account too. They can create an account again if they need.
Failed to remove the selected user at this time. Please try again later.
Successfully remove the selected user from PBC. That email holder can create new account in PBC again with same email.
Failed to modify the user role at this time. Please try again later.
Successfully modify the user role. Now this user can perform as selected role in PBC application.
